title: Cobblemon Ride Speed Stabilizer
description: Nerfs the top speed of fast Cobblemon rides (bird, jet, dolphin, submarine, hover) by around 45% to reduce server lag from chunk loading. Handling, acceleration, and stamina are untouched. Horse-tier rides are not nerfed.
body:
## 🐎 Cobblemon Ride Speed Stabilizer

Ever flown or swam on a Cobblemon and watched your server choke because the chunks can't load fast enough? This datapack trims the **top speed** of the fastest rides so your server stays smooth, without making them feel bad to ride.

### ✨ What it changes

Only `speedExpr` (maximum speed) is reduced by roughly **~45%**. Acceleration, handling, stamina, and jump are **left untouched**, so your Pokémon still feel responsive and snappy, they just don't fly fast enough to destroy your TPS.

| Ride Type    | Old Speed (max / min) | New Speed (max / min) |
|--------------|-----------------------|-----------------------|
| 🐦 Bird       | 20.0 / 4.0            | 11.0 / 2.2            |
| 🐬 Dolphin    | 24.0 / 2.0            | 13.2 / 1.1            |
| 🛩️ Jet        | 24.0 / 4.0            | 13.2 / 2.2            |
| 🚁 Hover      | 20.0 / 1.0            | 11.0 / 0.55           |
| 🌊 Submarine  | 12.0 / 2.0            | 6.6 / 1.1             |

### 🐴 What is NOT nerfed

Rides whose speed is already at or below horse-tier are left alone, because their speed was reasonable to begin with:

- `horse` (baseline, 1.2)
- `boat` (0.75)
- `vehicle`, `minekart` (1.0)
- `glider`, `helicopter` (1.0)
- `rocket` (0.5)
- `burst` (1)

### 🎯 Why use this?

- ✅ **Server-friendly** — reduces lag spikes caused by fast flying/swimming rides loading chunks too quickly.
- ✅ **Not brutal** — rides are still far faster than walking and flying/swimming still feels great.
- ✅ **Handling preserved** — acceleration, skill, stamina, and jump are unchanged.
- ✅ **Drop-in** — just put it in your `datapacks` folder, `/reload`, and go.

### 📦 How to install

1. Download the datapack `.zip`.
2. Place it in `saves/<yourworld>/datapacks/`.
3. Join the world and run `/reload`, or restart the world.
4. Done.

### 🧩 Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.x (pack_format 15+, match it to your Cobblemon version)
- **Required mod:** [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon)
- Safe to stack with other Cobblemon datapacks that **don't** overwrite files in `data/cobblemon/ride_settings/`.

### ⚙️ Want to tweak it yourself?

Open any JSON in `data/cobblemon/ride_settings/` and adjust the first two numbers inside `speedExpr` to taste. The values are blocks per second (max / min).

### 💖 Support the developer

If this datapack helps you or your server, consider dropping a tip so I can keep making more Cobblemon content:

👉 **[Support me on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/epromite/tip)** ☕

Thanks a lot, and enjoy lag-free Cobblemon rides! 🎮✨
